decisions.reason: As a flagship adapter tightly linked to the firm’s core track-lighting know-how, it fits existing capabilities well and is therefore more likely to be refined than withdrawn.
This LED luminaire line is very close to the firm’s established premium lighting business, so the firm can absorb market feedback and improve it with its existing design and engineering resources.

The home automation server box still builds on the firm’s lighting-control offer, but it is the most capability-stretching product here and so faces a higher risk of withdrawal if learning and commercial uptake prove weaker.
A luminaire family sits squarely within the firm’s core product and brand competence, making continued support and incremental development more probable than exit.
